category: cheap managed cloud, ZFS-backed, Cloudreve-family front end

free_tier.stated: 10 GB free forever with no payment required. Paid annually: 100 GB at USD 6.79, 500 GB at USD 13.49, 2 TB at USD 33.99, 6 TB at USD 112.49, one user and no per-seat fee

per_object_cap.stated: 5 GB on the 100 GB tier, 10 GB on 500 GB, 15 GB on 2 TB and 20 GB on 6 TB, so the cap rises with the tier and never clears 20 GB

retention.stated: While the subscription runs. No retention clock published

egress.terms: Not metered in the published plan table; unlimited devices, WebDAV mounting and rclone are bundled into every paid tier

tooling: rclone webdav and rclone s3. The drive host answers OPTIONS with DAV: 1, 2 and Allow: OPTIONS, LOCK, PUT, MKCOL, so the WebDAV server is real. A REST sync API and Windows, macOS and Android apps exist
chaining: At USD 1.42/TB/month on the 2 TB plan this is cheaper per terabyte than any storage VPS in the survey and cheaper than a lifetime deal on a three-year horizon. WebDAV plus S3 with no egress line makes it a candidate durable tier under a free hot set

limits.value: 20 GB on the 6 TB plan, the largest cap at the largest tier
the front end is a Cloudreve fork and its /api/v3 endpoints return 404, so stock Cloudreve tooling does not apply

identity_cost.detail: an email address. The free 10 GB plan needs no payment method

reliability_note: Indian-operated with INR billing and Mumbai, Bengaluru and Delhi regions. The app., my. and cloud. subdomains do not resolve, so only drive.quixicloud.com is live and the marketing site is ahead of the DNS. The front end is Cloudreve-derived and its /api/v3 endpoints 404, so it is a fork and not stock Cloudreve

evidence.proved: the full annual plan table: '2TB Cloud Storage, USD 34/year', 'Start Free, 10 GB, USD 0 forever. No payment required', and the per-tier single-file limits
OPTIONS returned HTTP 200 with Allow: OPTIONS, LOCK, PUT, MKCOL and dav: 1, 2, so the WebDAV write surface is live a GET returned 401 with 0 bytes
HTTP 200, a real login and registration app offering 'zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted cloud storage'
the same product with India pricing, 2 TB from INR 3,249/yr, and Mumbai, Bengaluru and Delhi regions

price_per_tb_month: USD 1.42/TB/month on the 2 TB plan at USD 33.99/yr, and USD 1.56/TB/month on 6 TB at USD 112.49/yr
notes: The best price per terabyte found anywhere in this topic, from an operator with a marketing site ahead of its DNS and a forked front end. Two things are unproven: that the no-egress-line claim survives contact, and that a 6 TB plan is provisioned as advertised. A 10 GB free tier needs no card, so both can be tested before paying.

extras.dns_defect: app., my. and cloud. subdomains do not resolve; only drive.quixicloud.com answers
